notes.title: Ready for your next adventure?
notes.content:
What can change the nature of a game… MythForce!

What is MythForce?


 Roguelike Dungeon Crawling ✅
 80s Cartoon Aesthetic ✅
 Take on the forces of Deadalus solo or with up to 3 friends ✅
 Play as a Knight, Mage, Hunter, or Rogue ✅
 Fun ✅

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010308/cd337c916573130b1661d471a7e4dbb43ae0c8ef.gif

Check it out during Steam Next Fest from June 19th - June 26th 📅

Already tried out the demo? Add MythForce to your wishlist and join our Discord: 
https://discord.gg/MythForce
